raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Currently one can choose a global attention backend or a specific backend per component. This PR adds support to choose attention backend per component for each role. That is, a different backend for self-attention and cross-attention. The motivation here is that when using quantized attention backends, there's a quantization overhead prior to running the lower precision kernel. This overhead is mostly worth it in self-attention, but cross-attention calls are often so light that the overhead can be enough for the entire call to be slower than the un-quantized counterpart. The backend can be chosen via the component backend selection: ``` --component-attention-backends.transformer.self=backend_1 -component-attention-backends.transformer.cross=backend_2 ``` The backend choice tree is as follows: 1. selected_attention_backend - explicit arg passed directly into `get_attn_backend()` 2. Global forced backend - `get_global_forced_attn_backend()`, set via `global_force_attn_backend()` (programmatic override) 3. Component + role override - `get_component_forced_attn_backend_for_role(attention_role)`, i.e. the config key transformer.cross / transformer.self 4. Component-wide override - `get_component_forced_attn_backend()`, i.e. the config key transformer (no role suffix) 5. CLI global - `--attention-backend` flag 6. `default_attention_backend` 7. Platform default - if everything above is None, platform picks This now only adds the choice via the `--component-attention-backends`. If desired, I can also add a `--cross-attention-backend` flag. ## Modifications - Enhances the component-attention-backend to support self/cross attn as well - Adds AttentionRole enum used to specify self/cross role (can support others, like joint, as well, if needed) - Stores role-qualified entries in a separate `component_attention_backend_roles` map rather than in `component_attention_backends`, so consumers that look a component up by name are unaffected by a role key ## Accuracy Tests Here the self was `aiter` and cross is `aiter_sage`. Both are used as expected. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3cfabbf1-b440-4aad-bf3b-637cfae01906 Output is good. ## Speed Tests and Profiling ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. +# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Attention roles.
+
+A "role" distinguishes the type of attention a layer performs (self-attention
+vs cross-attention) so a different backend can be selected per role. The value
+strings double as the role token accepted in ``--component-attention-backends``
+keys, e.g. ``transformer.cross``; ``ServerArgs`` splits those entries out of
+``component_attention_backends`` into ``component_attention_backend_roles`` so a
+component lookup by name never sees a role-qualified key.
+"""
+
+import enum
+
+
+class AttentionRole(str, enum.Enum):
+    SELF = "self"
+    CROSS = "cross"
+
+
+# Separator between the component name and the role token in a
+# ``--component-attention-backends`` key (e.g. ``transformer.cross``).
+ROLE_KEY_SEPARATOR = "."
+
+
+def make_component_role_key(component: str, role: AttentionRole) -> str:
+    """Build a role-qualified config key from a component name and role."""
+    return f"{component}{ROLE_KEY_SEPARATOR}{role.value}"
+
+
+def split_component_role_key(key: str) -> tuple[str, AttentionRole | None]:
+    """Split a ``component`` or ``component.role`` config key.
+
+    Returns the component part and the parsed ``AttentionRole`` (or ``None`` when
+    the key carries no role suffix). Raises ``ValueError`` if a role suffix is
+    present but is not a valid role token.
+    """
+    component_part, sep, role_part = key.rpartition(ROLE_KEY_SEPARATOR)
+    if not sep:
+        return key, None
+    try:
+        role = AttentionRole(role_part.strip().lower())
+    except ValueError:
+        valid_roles = sorted(r.value for r in AttentionRole)
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Invalid attention role '{role_part}' in component key '{key}'. "
+            f"Available roles are: {valid_roles}"
+        ) from None
+    return component_part, role

+            backend_by_role={AttentionRole.CROSS: AttentionBackendEnum.FA},
+            component_backend=AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA,
+        )
+
+        self.assertIs(backend, _FakeFABackend)
+
+    def test_role_sparse_backend_downgrades_for_cross(self):
+        # A sparse backend chosen via the cross role still downgrades to dense.

+            is_cross_attention=True,
+            supported={AttentionBackendEnum.FA, AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA},
+            backend_by_role={AttentionRole.CROSS: AttentionBackendEnum.LASER_ATTN},
+        )
+
+        self.assertIs(backend, _FakeFABackend)
